title: Latest on Iran: Trump's ‘Madman Doctrine,' Israeli Intervention, and More
author: Prem Thakker
content:
Could the Islamic Republic of Iran be standing on its last leg? How close are
we getting to a US and Israeli war against Iran? Does Reza Pahlavi have actual
support inside Iran?

In this **Zeteo** Town Hall Q&A, moderated by **Prem Thakker, Negar
Mortazavi** and **Sina Toossi** discuss the latest news out of Iran, where
[thousands](https://apnews.com/article/iran-protests-us-israel-war-nuclear-
economy-1b2368e0804676d33d6aa0696815a102) of people have reportedly been
killed during ongoing protests across more than [180
cities](https://www.cnn.com/2026/01/12/middleeast/iran-mass-protests-
explained-intl?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email). This conversation was
recorded just as personnel at a US military base in Qatar were being
[urged](https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/iran-protests-trump-01-14-26?post-
id=cmke1mnuf00003b6uzmo9755b) to leave amid fears that Trump could launch
[another](https://zeteo.com/p/six-ways-trumps-bombing-of-iran-
made?utm_source=publication-search&utm_medium=email) military attack against
Iran.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe?)

Mortazavi, editor and host of 'The Iran Podcast', and**** Toossi, senior
nonresident fellow at the Center for International Policy, also took questions
from the audience, including on:

  * Trump's seriousness in launching military strikes on Iran

  * Israel's role in what's happening on the ground

  * The slowing pace of protests and what that means for the Iranian regime

  * The role that Reza Pahlavi, son of Iran's last shah, is playing

  * The success of past reform moments - and what lessons can be learned this time

  * And more.

Watch now and let us know what you think in the comments. We'll be continuing
coverage of this developing story, so stay tuned.
